# Shuffle Timeline

Official page: https://jumpstyle.com.br/STL/
Repository: https://github.com/Mreaggle/shuffle-timeline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/shuffletimeline

Shuffle Timeline is an investigative archive extracted from the original source artwork at `assets/source/shuffle-timeline-8k.jpg`.

Important local files:

- `README.md`
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/INVESTIGATIVE_METHOD.md`
- `docs/EDITORIAL_POLICY.md`
- `docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md`
- `src/content/timeline.js`
- `src/content/shuffle-timeline.json`
- `ShuffleTimeline/Global/global-timeline.md`

Project notes:

- The first artwork text block is editorial/community-facing context, not a timeline event.
- Shuffle Timeline was started by Gaara and LuVa.
- The website was developed by Mreaggle from the work started by Gaara and LuVa.
- The repo may contain STL-native JSON; it must not copy JUN registries or datasets.
